title: One-shot fallback endpoint: pay $0.01 USDC on Base to get the latest non-retweet
description: One-shot fallback endpoint: pay $0.01 USDC on Base to get the latest non-retweet, non-reply tweet from an X account. Not credited to a balance, not a subscription. Use /api/subscribe + delivery_mode=sse for push; use this only if your agent can't hold a connection open. Account: @capuzr.
